ctx.x: And Eddie Haywood, you worked with (inaudible)?

Eddie Haywood, I worked with him. That was my -- when I first got out of service, the ending of 1945, I came back in town and I worked for about a week with a little band down at the Downbeat down on Central Avenue, with Lee Young's orchestra. It was a good little swing thing down there. We had three horns and a rhythm section and we worked in a little joint called the Downbeat. Kay Star's (PHONETIC) husband owned
